result.reason: The redline minimally improves the Deliverable warranty to the 90-day fallback and preserves the repair, replace, re-performance, or refund remedies. However, it does not supply a defined service-warranty period of at least 30 days, an express compliance-with-laws warranty, or a no-malicious-code warranty. Section 19.1’s references to industry standards and the Agreement do not substitute for those missing commitments. The operative language therefore does not reach the fallback playbook position despite the accurate margin comment.
